correctness.rationale: Fix complemented infinite-dimensional Hilbertian H⊂X, with projection constant profile Γ=inf_{infinite closed H0⊂H} λ_X(H0). For c<Γ select sufficiently small ε and Tε=(εP,I−P):X→H⊕∞ker(P), invertible with in(Tε)≤ε. If a perturbation F of norm s<cε makes ker(Tε−F) infinite-dimensional, the projection P maps it isomorphically onto a closed infinite-dimensional H0. The inverse graph map J=h+k(h) has ||k||≤s/(1−s); the orthogonal Q:H→H0 makes A=ε⁻¹ Q F1|H0 within θ=s²/[ε(1−s)]<1 of I. The projection R=A⁻¹ ε⁻¹ QF1:X→H0 has ||R||≤s(1−s)/[ε(1−s)−s²]<Γ, impossible. Independent exact symbolic differentiation of the rational bound verified its monotonicity in s and checked stated ε restrictions; the infinite-kernel distance formula is a named primary-source premise. Thus Λ_SF(X)≥Γ_Hilb(X) by c↑Γ; Γ=1, infinite Γ, and Hilbert-space sharpness handled. No finite experiment is offered as a theorem proof.
